description: This file defines the ResourceManager class responsible for resource management tasks such as handling resource observers, setup based on modules, and notifications within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for singleton instantiation, observer setup, and communication, indicating it's a key component for resource control.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: Singleton class that manages resources, observers, and notifications within SuiteCRM, handling setup based on modules and resource limits.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ResourceManager.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes resource observers based on the provided module name, and applies resource limits if configured.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Sends notification messages to all registered observers, typically about resource limits being reached.

methods.name: getObservers
methods.description: Returns the list of currently registered observer instances.
